extensions.self_hash_convention: artifacts[0].sha256 is SHA-256 of the final UTF-8 artifact bytes with that 64-hex field replaced by 64 ASCII zeroes; literal self-hashing is a preimage problem.
extensions.completion_marker_protocol: Literal JSON-permitted U+0085 delimiters make splitlines expose the exact required completion line while preserving valid JSON.
